questions.question: How did Jonathan warn David whether Saul meant to kill him?
options: By sending a sealed letter through a servant
By shooting arrows as a prearranged signal
By lighting a fire on the hill at night
By meeting him secretly at the city gate
questions.answer: By shooting arrows as a prearranged signal
